text:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: Reserved GPU pool 'resv-east-2' saturated (100% reserved). Multiple enterprise tenants reporting enqueue delays. BrightLeaf showing 95%+ reservation usage and queue depth up ~320% last 10m. SEV2. Paging on-call :rotating_light: https://internal.monitoring/alerts/ALERT-6145

kai: ack, I'm oncall. jumping in. anyone already on a bridge?

customer-bridge-bot: Bridge for BrightLeaf created: https://bridges.redwood/6145209999 (msg to CSM included).

marta: I see the same on dashboards — resv-east-2 reserved_slots=128 used=128 queued=412 (baseline ~90). latency tail is spiking.

samir: autoscaler logs show repeated failures to request extra nodes from cloud provider: "scale_up blocked: quota_exceeded". Looks like committed capacity limit has been hit for this org's region.

kai: copy. runbook step 1: confirm noisy tenant vs reservation exhaustion. samir can you paste the autoscaler error snippet?

samir: sure. logs:
```
2026-03-15T01:12:04Z autoscaler: scale_up attempt for pool=resv-east-2 failed: provider_api error 403 QuotaExceeded: Requested GPUs would exceed quota. request_id=02f3c
2026-03-15T01:12:17Z autoscaler: retrying backoff=30s
2026-03-15T01:13:01Z autoscaler: scale_up attempt blocked by policy: reserved_commitments_full
```

marta: hmm. monitor shows one tenant (brightleaf-prod) has a sustained spike in concurrent sessions. But there are also a few BE (best-effort) tenants with long-running jobs on dedicated nodes — possible noisy neighbor.

liz: I'm running a quick query on reservations: `SELECT tenant, reserved_gpus, active_sessions FROM reservations WHERE pool='resv-east-2' ORDER BY active_sessions DESC LIMIT 10;` result: BrightLeaf 64/64 active, AcmeAnalytics 16/16 active, others small.

kai: so reserved commitments are saturated. We need immediate mitigations: 1) reduce BE workload on the pool (evict or throttle best-effort), 2) enable burst override if allowed, 3) route eligible BrightLeaf traffic to resv-west-1 if compatibility permits.

runbook-bot: Runbook: Dedicated pool saturation -> https://runbooks.redwood/dedicated-saturation. Recommended play: apply soft-eviction, enable short-term emergency-burst(30m), open customer bridge.

ops-bot: Executing soft-eviction for best-effort tenants on resv-east-2: `redwoodctl pool evict --pool resv-east-2 --policy soft --targets best-effort --max-sessions 0`

ops-bot: Eviction started — estimated reclaim ~8 GPUs in 90s.

marta: evictions reclaimed 7 GPUs so far but queue still growing (now queued=365). Looks like BrightLeaf ramp is outpacing reclaimed capacity.

samir: checking infra quotas — we are at provider-level reserved GPU soft-limit for region us-east-2 (customer-dedicated-commits + burst nodes). Cloud account has spare quota but not enough immediate provisionable GPUs due to internal quota guardrails. Request to infra-eng required to bump immediate burst cap.

kai: @liz, can we temporarily reduce BrightLeaf concurrency via throttling on the API gateway (rate-limit per API key) as a protective measure?

liz: yes. I can apply a per-tenant concurrency cap for BrightLeaf from 64->40 while we stabilize. Applying now.

liz: applied rate-limit: concurrency_cap=40 for tenant=brightleaf-prod.

marta: queue depth dropped ~18% in 60s. Good signal.

samir: we also patched the autoscaler to ignore the provider soft-quota check as an emergency measure (will require escalation approval). Command: `autoscaler set-override --pool resv-east-2 --ignore-quota-check true --expires-in 00:30:00`. Doing as emergency with audit log.

kai: approved (SRE lead). Samir, proceed but DM infra-eng to followup for permanent quota increase.

samir: override applied. requesting cloud provider scale again.

ops-bot: Scale request submitted: add 10 GPUs to resv-east-2 (burst nodes). Request id cp-9982.

pagerduty-bot: NOTE: change to capacity will generate billing delta. Confirmed with finance-ops. :money_with_wings:

customer-bridge-bot: BrightLeaf notified of temporary throttling and mitigation steps. CSM on call acknowledged.

marta: within 4 minutes after override + throttle + evictions we reclaimed ~15 GPUs and queue is trending down (queued=220) and tail p90 latency decreasing.

samir: cloud provider accepted scale request and nodes are provisioning. Some older stuck jobs prevented immediate packing; forcing preemption on best-effort freed additional capacity.

kai: good. next steps: keep throttles in place, monitor queue and errors for 30m. If we see re-growth, escalate to infra-eng for permanent quota bump and consider tenant-level throttling policy for BrightLeaf.

liz: adding an alert mute for noisy signals so we don't flood paging while we stabilize.

marta: also added a short-term routing rule to send 20% of new BrightLeaf traffic to resv-west-1 (model compatibility confirmed) to reduce pressure.

samir: logs show autoscaler health stabilized after scale complete. No further quota errors.

kai: oncall handoff in 45m to day team. I'll summarize for post-incident: root cause = reserved commitments saturated by BrightLeaf ramp + lack of immediate burst quota due to provider guardrails; contributing = long-running best-effort sessions on dedicated pool. Mitigations = soft-eviction of BE jobs, emergency autoscaler override, per-tenant concurrency cap, cross-region routing.

customer-bridge-bot: BrightLeaf said impact reduced, still seeing some request retries but accepting mitigation. CSM will follow up for postmortem call.

kai: OK folks — keep monitoring 15m, then I'll hand off. Good work. :thumbsup:

marta: filing incident ticket and will attach metrics + timelines.

samir: filed for infra-eng: quota-bump request ticket INFRA-2381.

liz: handing off to day-shift at 07:30 UTC with notes.

kai: last check — queued=70, p95 latency returning to normal. Closing active pager in 10m unless regression.

pagerduty-bot: Pager resolved for SEV2 (status: mitigated) — please complete post-incident review in 72 hours.
